name: Camp Akeela
description_short: Overnight summer camp in Thetford Center, Vermont, offering two three-week sessions in 2027. Tuition is all-inclusive, apart from baggage shipping and optional return transportation, and includes a one-way bus ride to camp.
special_needs_notes: The page points families to CampLauncher, which provides needs-based camperships to neurodivergent youth. The site menu includes "How We Approach Social Skills." This page does not say whether the camp serves a specific population.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page also lists a separate Family Camp (Aug 12–17, 2027, $4400, plus $750 per person for guests beyond 4; cabins hold up to 10). This is a family program, not a camper session, so it is not included in sessions.
Beyond Akeela 2027 sessions are listed as TBA and are not recorded.
Financial aid comes from outside organizations (CampLauncher, ESS). The camp itself offers payment plans.
The camp has a winter office at 314 Bryn Mawr Avenue, Bala Cynwyd, PA 19004 (Sept 1 – May 31). The address recorded is the Vermont summer camp address.
